units.source_en: The known forces of nature can be divided into four classes:

paragraphs.source_en: 1. Gravity. This is the weakest of the four, but it is a long-range force and acts on everything in the universe as an attraction. This means that for large bodies the gravitational forces all add up and can dominate over all other forces.

This means that for large bodies the gravitational forces all add up and can dominate over all other forces.

ja.t: になりうるということである。

paragraphs.source_en: 2. Electromagnetism. This is also long-range and is much stronger than gravity, but it acts only on particles with an electric charge, being repulsive between charges of the same sign and attractive between charges of the opposite sign. This means the electric forces between large bodies cancel each other out, but on the scales of atoms and molecules they dominate. Electromagnetic forces are responsible for all of chemistry and biology.
